name: Octree-based Isosurfacing
definition: Using an octree as a spatial discretization structure instead of a Cartesian grid for isosurfacing methods like Marching Cubes and Dual Contouring. This allows for adaptive resolution but loses guarantees, potentially causing cracks in Marching Cubes if the octree is not adapted to the surface.
summary: Octree-based isosurfacing uses adaptive octrees for variable-resolution surface extraction, sacrificing topological guarantees to refine only where geometry demands it.
